name: Integrated Plastics Machinery
old_description: Since 2002, we have represented the top equipment suppliers for the plastics industry, but it doesn't end there. We work with our customers from start to finish. From consultation and equipment recommendation, to purchasing, training, and even equipment maintenance and repair. We will do our very best to make sure you are set on a path to success, and with over 90 years of combined experience, we pride ourselves on providing comprehensive and lasting solutions for the plastics industry.
about:
Integrated Plastics Machinery is based in Corona, California, and was founded in 2002. The company began as a representative for leading equipment suppliers to the plastics industry, leveraging the founders' combined decades of experience to offer a full range of services from equipment selection to ongoing support.

The firm provides end-to-end support for plastics processors, including technical consulting on part design, tooling, and material selection; factory-based training programs covering basic to advanced molding techniques; and a service department staffed by cross-trained technicians who handle preventive maintenance, inspections, and troubleshooting across mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic/pneumatic systems. The company does not manufacture equipment itself but acts as a distributor and service partner for multiple supplier lines.

Its customer base consists of plastics manufacturers and molders seeking turn-key solutions for new production lines or existing equipment optimization. The company serves the broader plastics industry, though specific client names are not disclosed.

Integrated Plastics Machinery emphasizes its 90-plus years of combined industry experience and its commitment to guiding clients from concept through production, positioning itself as a single-source partner for equipment procurement, training, and long-term maintenance.
